zh-Hans: 按创建者浏览文件时，可切换项目工作区、按格式筛选并继续加载。
内置 CLI 支持按创建者查询，返回项目与工作区信息。独立 Agent Skill 已停用。
修复应用包图标和切换目录后的列表滚动位置。
en: Switch between project worktrees, filter by file extension, and load more files in the By Creator view.
Query activity by creator with the built-in CLI and see project and worktree details. The standalone Agent Skill has been retired.
Fixed app bundle icons and scroll position when navigating between folders.
